## Optional build inputs (2)

Not in this repository and never downloaded by it: compiled in only when the build sets the option (official releases do). Each input attributes its own files.

| Input | Option | Title | Author | Licence | Source | Attribution | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kition-fonts` | `KITION_FONTS_DIR` | Japanese, Arabic and Telugu faces, when the checkout holds them (the public kition-fonts holds BIZ UDPGothic, BIZ UDMincho, Shippori Mincho and Noto Sans Arabic; Kition's builds don't set the variable, so they compile in none) | Each face's authors, as the checkout's ATTRIBUTION.md lists them | OFL-1.1 | https://github.com/KitionAI/kition-fonts (a checkout next to this repository, or KITION_FONTS_DIR) | https://github.com/KitionAI/kition-fonts/blob/main/ATTRIBUTION.md | crates/support/fonts/build.rs compiles in a checkout's Jpan, Arab and Telu faces (not its Chinese, Latin or emoji faces): Japanese fallback in the interface and Japanese glyphs in edited PDF text; Arabic and Telugu interface text; the web build only BIZ UDPGothic Regular and the Arab and Telu faces. It never embeds Source Han, Source Sans, Source Serif or Noto CJK (AGENTS.md §1.1). A build that compiles a face in must add its licence to NOTICE |
| `kition-fonts` | `KITION_FONTS_DIR` | Chinese font: Droid Sans Fallback | Ascender Corporation for Google; The Android Open Source Project | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/KitionAI/kition-fonts (a checkout next to this repository, or KITION_FONTS_DIR) | https://github.com/KitionAI/kition-fonts/blob/main/ATTRIBUTION.md | Kition's web editor (web/scripts/build-engine.sh copies it into the web build and hands it to addFont): the face for Chinese CID fonts a PDF names but does not embed (Adobe-GB1, Adobe-CNS1), and Japanese ones when no kition-fonts face is compiled in. Not Adobe's and not derived from Source Han (AGENTS.md §1.1) |
